meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

copy.tagline_en: Deploy AI Runway onto an AKS cluster in minutes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up AI inference on Azure

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会带你从空 AKS 集群走到模型跑起来：依次校验集群、安装 controller、评估 GPU、选装推理 provider、部署首个模型并验证。每步报告健康状态，安装或部署前先征求你同意。
howto.when: 当你提到「setup AI Runway」「airunway setup」「run LLM on AKS」等，或要求把模型部署到 AKS、安装 AI Runway controller 时触发。前提是已有 AKS 集群，否则会先转给 azure-kubernetes 技能。

howto.what_en: Claude walks you from a bare AKS cluster to a running model: verifies the cluster, installs the controller, assesses GPUs, installs an inference provider, deploys a first model, and confirms before each install.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "setup AI Runway", "airunway setup", "run LLM on AKS" and similar, or ask to deploy a model to AKS or install the AI Runway controller. Requires an existing AKS cluster.
